labels.caption: The ablations of critical-ratio renting (A9, Sublet's inner policy) and the transplants against Sublet on weeks 101 of part main (1 weeks, policy seed 0): per week the difference from Sublet of the cost over all-fallback under the trace lender ($\Delta r_0$) and of the worst cost over the five stress lenders ($\Delta W_0$); medians over the weeks with 95\% week-bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples, seed 20261031; descriptive, the weeks being rotations of one series). Sublet is the origin; positive is worse. (a) Critical-ratio renting and its ablations, with $\Delta W_0$ on a scale linear within $\pm0.02$ and logarithmic beyond; (b) greedy renting with critical-ratio renting's notice layer and with Sublet's guard, RetroRenting-style with critical-ratio renting's contract rule and make-before-break (arrows from the base policy, in its color), and Sublet's guard without projection. Critical-ratio renting and its ablation ``no insurance'' have equal medians and intervals (one name). Sublet, one-way; and the ablations ``no make-before-break'' and ``no commitment rule'' and ``no site marking'' have a lower $W_0$ than Sublet: median $\Delta W_0$ $-$0.012 and $-$0.178 and $-$0.052 and $-$0.021, respectively (intervals below 0), at a median $\Delta r_0$ of $-$0.2642 and $-$0.2710 and $-$0.2982 and 0.0403. Per-week values in Table~\ref{tab:e7v2-weeks}.
